Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Celebrating a Photography Award and Planning a Vacation Trip
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your close friend, Dan, who recently won first prize in a national photography contest. Read part of his email below:

"I have some wonderful news to share—I just won first prize in the National Youth Photography Competition! As part of the award, I received a 4-day travel vacation voucher, and I would love for you to come with me to the award ceremony and join the trip afterwards! Could you let me know what day and time you can arrive? During our stay, would you prefer staying at a cozy local homestay or a 4-star hotel? Also, what exciting activities or sightseeing spots would you like us to do together while we are there?"

Write an email responding to Dan. You should write at least 120 words. You do not need to include your name or address.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Education is the Key to the Future
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"It is widely believed that education is the key to the future, empowering individuals to achieve personal success and enabling nations to develop sustainably."

Write an essay to an educated reader explaining the importance of education for individuals and society. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or personal experience to support your view. You should write at least 250 words.
